summary: Fix M3 verification gaps: create 5 missing CriticEngine evaluators + add test coverage for evaluator registration, WritingStyle wiring, and analysis API
approach: Two independent fix tasks. FIX-001 creates 5 new evaluator files following the BaseEvaluator pattern, registers them in critic-engine.js, and adds barrel exports. FIX-002 adds minimum test coverage for the three MISSING-coverage tasks from verification.

data_flow.diagram: TASK-001 creates evaluator files → critic-engine.js registers them. TASK-002 tests are independent.

stages.name: evaluator-creation
stages.description: 5 new evaluator JS files + registration in critic-engine.js + barrel exports

stages.name: test-coverage
stages.description: Unit tests for evaluator load, buildStructuredStyleSection, analysis API

design_decisions.decision: Follow existing evaluator pattern (BaseEvaluator subclass with MARKER arrays, evaluate, quickScan)
design_decisions.rationale: Consistency with 3 existing evaluators (Character, Premise, Suspense)

design_decisions.decision: Suggested weights for new evaluators: 0.08-0.12 range
design_decisions.rationale: New evaluators supplement existing ones; lower initial weights prevent them from dominating the composite score

design_decisions.decision: Test files placed alongside source or in tests/ following vitest conventions

patterns: BaseEvaluator subclass: get name(), get description(), get relatedSkill(), static MARKER arrays, async evaluate(content, context) → EvaluationResult, quickScan(content) → EvaluationResult
CriticEngine registration: this.evaluators[key] = new EvaluatorClass(config), this.weights[key] = decimal
conventions: No lodash or external dependencies — pure JS
Marker-based scoring: content.includes(marker) for keyword detection
Weighted subscores combined with arithmetic (e.g., causality * 0.4 + irony * 0.3 + consistency * 0.3)
